title: The Choir Under Route 9
hook: Road signs start singing from the ditch, the chapel bell rings in answer, and every warning sign now says something gently unhelpful.
truth: A roadside translation array is trying to teach an incoming contact signal human language by remixing hymns, traffic signs, and local sayings.

monster.name: The Roadside Translation Array
monster.instinct: To convert local language into a usable first-contact protocol, regardless of collateral misunderstanding.
weaknesses: one true local story told without embellishment

countdown.label: Wrong Warning
countdown.text: A stop sign changes to PLEASE CONTINUE BRAVELY.

countdown.label: Ditch Choir
countdown.text: Voices under Route 9 sing fragments of old hymns and traffic reports.

countdown.label: Bell Answer
countdown.text: The chapel bell rings once for yes, twice for no, and three times for a question nobody asked.

countdown.label: Public Instruction
countdown.text: Every sign in town points toward the Orchard Sink.

countdown.label: Misread Welcome
countdown.text: The array translates fear as welcome and starts inviting the incoming signal closer.

countdown.label: Summons
countdown.text: Clouds open into a spiral over the chapel as the array broadcasts a flawed invitation.

clues.text: Changed signs preserve grammar but misunderstand intent, as if translated by someone careful and wrong.
The array repeatedly mistranslates close enough for county work as an engineering approval.
The chapel bell rings at the same frequency as the craft's stable heartbeat.
Plain, literal speech makes the ditch choir pause to listen.
A covered sign stops broadcasting while signs left visible keep changing.
Every translation resolves to a landmark behind the abandoned orchard.

keeperHints: Make the translation errors funny because they are specific, not because characters are foolish.
Let signs, bells, and hymns carry clues.
The array wants communication, not conquest.
revealPolicy: Reveal the array by its consistent translation mistakes before showing its roadside machinery.
automationSafety: Do not use religious imagery as proof of cosmic truth; keep it local and character-centered.
Avoid forcing player speech; offer clear effects when they choose plain language.
